gini.justification: Income inequality. Below the admission floor (33 of 54 states) at 2024; descriptive, shown and not scored.

non_state_deaths.display_name: Deaths in non-state conflict (fighting between organised groups), per 100,000 people
non_state_deaths.justification: Horizontal cohesion between communities (plan 1.2): UCDP's best estimate of deaths in fighting between organised groups, neither of them a government, inside the country's borders in the year: the plan's communal violence. A year without it is a measured zero. Edition 2, step 9.

youth_unemployment.display_name: Unemployment, youth (% of the labour force aged 15 to 24, modelled ILO estimate)
youth_unemployment.justification: The inclusion of youth, which Interpeace names (plan 1.1, 1.2). Shown and not scored: measured unemployment is higher in Africa's richer states, where informal work is rarer, so its direction is contradicted (the candidate screen of 2026-10-18).

refugees_hosted.display_name: Refugees under the mandate of the UNHCR by country or territory of asylum, per 100,000 people
refugees_hosted.justification: Refugees hosted: a strain on services and on relations between hosts and newcomers. UNHCR records zeros, so a gap is a gap.

slum_population.display_name: Population living in slums (% of urban population)
slum_population.justification: How unevenly the city's gains are shared.

female_male_labour.display_name: Ratio of female to male labor force participation rate (%) (modeled ILO estimate)
female_male_labour.justification: How evenly economic opportunity is shared between women and men. Can pass 100, so no theoretical bounds.

urban_growth.justification: Fast urban growth strains housing, services and the social fabric of cities.

primary_gpi.display_name: School enrollment, primary, gender parity index (GPI)
primary_gpi.justification: Gender parity in primary enrolment, folded so that parity scores best. Opportunity shared between girls and boys. Edition 2, step 6: variant B (P57) leaves it out; descriptive, shown and not scored.

secondary_gpi.display_name: School enrollment, secondary, gender parity index (GPI)
secondary_gpi.justification: Gender parity in secondary enrolment, folded so that parity scores best. Below the admission floor (33 of 54 states) at 2024; descriptive, shown and not scored.

water_stress.display_name: Level of water stress: freshwater withdrawal as a proportion of available freshwater resources
water_stress.justification: Resource depletion (SDG 6.4.2). Can pass 100, so no theoretical bounds.

pm25.display_name: PM2.5 air pollution, mean annual exposure (micrograms per cubic meter)

resource_depletion.display_name: Adjusted savings, natural resources depletion (% of GNI)
resource_depletion.justification: Natural capital run down to fund current income.

disaster_displacement.display_name: Internally displaced persons, new displacement associated with disasters, per 100,000 people
disaster_displacement.justification: People forced from home by floods, storms, drought and other hazards in the year (IDMC via the WDI).

forest_area.justification: Forest cover, which holds soil and water.

co2_pc.display_name: CO2 emissions, AR5 GWP100 (metric tons per capita)
co2_pc.justification: CO2 emissions per person: a wealth proxy (rho -.93 with GDP per capita), not a pressure on the country (plan 4.2). Edition 2, step 6: variant B (P57) leaves it out; descriptive, shown and not scored.

freshwater_withdraw.display_name: Annual freshwater withdrawals, total (% of internal resources)
freshwater_withdraw.justification: Annual freshwater withdrawals. A near-duplicate of water stress, the SDG measure, so edition 2, step 6: variant B (P57) leaves it out; descriptive, shown and not scored.

nonrenew_elec.display_name: Electricity production from oil, gas, and coal sources (% of total)
nonrenew_elec.justification: Electricity from fossil fuels: the energy mix, not an environmental pressure on the country. Edition 2, step 6: variant B (P57) leaves it out; descriptive, shown and not scored.

agri_land.justification: Agricultural land: no defended direction, as more farmland is not more stable. Edition 2, step 6: variant B (P57) leaves it out; descriptive, shown and not scored.

fuel_exports.justification: Dependence on oil and gas sales, and so on their world price.

ore_metal_exports.display_name: Ores and metals exports (% of merchandise exports)
ore_metal_exports.justification: Dependence on mineral sales and their world prices.

resource_rents.display_name: Total natural resources rents (% of GDP)
resource_rents.justification: How much of the economy is rent from natural resources: exposure to commodity prices and the incentive to fight over the rent.

aid_received.justification: Dependence on aid, which donors can cut.

remittances.justification: Income sent home by migrants, which tends to rise when the home economy is hit.

trade_openness.justification: How integrated the economy is with world markets.

fdi_inflows.display_name: Foreign direct investment, net inflows (% of GDP)
fdi_inflows.justification: Long-term foreign investment in the economy.

gdp_total.justification: The economy's size, in current US dollars. A large economy absorbs a shock to one sector or market more easily (P50: scored, on a log scale if the skew test asks).

domestic_credit_private.display_name: Domestic credit to private sector (% of GDP)
domestic_credit_private.justification: Domestic credit to the private sector: the depth of the financial system, part of the economy's structure. Edition 2, step 6: variant B (P57) leaves it out; descriptive, shown and not scored.

ge_estimate.justification: The quality of public services and the civil service, and the credibility of the government's commitment to its policies: the core of state capacity. WGI, Kaufmann, Kraay and Mastruzzi (2010), N(0,1) scale.

rl_estimate.display_name: Rule of Law, WGI estimated score
rl_estimate.justification: Confidence in and abidance by the rules of society: contracts, property, police and courts. Binding rules are what turn a decision into its execution. WGI, N(0,1) scale.

cc_estimate.display_name: Control of Corruption, WGI estimated score
cc_estimate.justification: The extent to which public power is exercised for private gain. A captured state cannot carry out policy as made. WGI, N(0,1) scale.

rq_estimate.justification: The government's ability to make policy that permits private sector development. A near-duplicate of government effectiveness (rho at least .90 in the candidate screen), so edition 2, step 6: variant B (P57) leaves it out; descriptive, shown and not scored.

cpia_property_rights.display_name: CPIA property rights and rule-based governance rating (1=low to 6=high)
cpia_property_rights.justification: The World Bank's assessment of how far property and contract rights are secured and governance is rule-based. Rated for IDA-eligible states only (41 of 54 at 2024); the scale's ends are its theoretical bounds.

statistical_performance.justification: The state's capacity to know its own population and economy: data use, services, products, sources and infrastructure. Distinct from income (rho .16 with log GDP per capita in the candidate screen).

tax_revenue.justification: The state's capacity to raise its own revenue, the fiscal base of everything else it does. 33 of 54 states at 2024: at the admission floor.

gdp_pc_ppp.justification: Income per person at purchasing power parity: what people have to live on (P50).

life_expect_tot.justification: Life expectancy at birth, the summary of a population's health.

under5_mortality.justification: Deaths of young children, the most sensitive measure of health services and living conditions.

maternal_mortality.display_name: Maternal mortality ratio (modeled estimate, per 100,000 live births)
maternal_mortality.justification: Women's health and the reach of care at birth; less redundant with life expectancy than infant mortality is.

stunting.display_name: Prevalence of stunting, height for age (modeled estimate, % of children under 5)

undernourishment.justification: Hunger: the share whose food intake falls short of what they need.

youth_literacy.display_name: Literacy rate, youth total (% of people ages 15-24)
youth_literacy.justification: Literacy among 15 to 24 year olds: whether schooling has reached the young.

primary_completion.display_name: Primary completion rate, total (% of relevant age group)
primary_completion.justification: Whether children finish primary school: an outcome, replacing enrolment, whose series stopped. A gross ratio, so it can pass 100 and takes no theoretical bounds.

elec_access_tot.justification: Access to electricity, a basic service.

water_access_pop.display_name: People using at least basic drinking water services (% of population)
water_access_pop.justification: At least basic drinking water, a basic service.

basic_sanitation.display_name: People using at least basic sanitation services (% of population)
basic_sanitation.justification: At least basic sanitation, a basic service.

internet_users.display_name: Individuals using the Internet (% of population)

mobile_subscriptions.justification: Connection; can pass 100, so no theoretical bounds.

youth_share.justification: The demographic transition: a young population needs schooling and jobs faster than an economy usually grows them.

population_growth.justification: The pace of the demographic transition.

adolescent_fertility.display_name: Adolescent fertility rate (births per 1,000 women ages 15-19)
adolescent_fertility.justification: Girls' and young women's opportunity, and the transition's pace (Interpeace's youth and women).

mort_infant.justification: Infant mortality. A near-duplicate of under-5 mortality and life expectancy, so edition 2, step 6: variant B (P57) leaves it out; descriptive, shown and not scored.

hand_washing_facil.display_name: People with basic handwashing facilities including soap and water (% of population)
hand_washing_facil.justification: Basic handwashing facilities at home. Edition 2, step 6: variant B (P57) leaves it out; descriptive, shown and not scored.

sev_food_insec.display_name: Prevalence of severe food insecurity (% of population)
sev_food_insec.justification: Severe food insecurity (FAO FIES). Undernourishment carries hunger in variant B, so edition 2, step 6: variant B (P57) leaves it out; descriptive, shown and not scored.

managed_water_percent.display_name: People using safely managed drinking water services (% of population)
managed_water_percent.justification: Safely managed drinking water. Below the admission floor (33 of 54 states) at 2024; descriptive, shown and not scored.

social_protection_labour_pop.display_name: Coverage of social protection and labor programs (% of population)
social_protection_labour_pop.justification: Coverage of social protection and labour programmes. Below the admission floor (33 of 54 states) at 2024; descriptive, shown and not scored.

population_total.justification: Total population: the denominator of every per-capita indicator, not scored.

inflation_5yr_avg.justification: Average consumer price inflation over five years. High and unstable inflation erodes incomes and savings and is the commonest macroeconomic crisis.

gdp_growth_3yr_avg.justification: Average real GDP growth over three years: whether the economy is expanding or contracting, smoothed over the business cycle.

growth_volatility.display_name: Volatility of real GDP growth: standard deviation over the last 10 years (percentage points)
growth_volatility.justification: How unsteady growth has been: the sample standard deviation of annual real growth over the trailing ten years, reported when at least five were measured.

external_debt.justification: The debt owed abroad, a stock that limits room to borrow in a shock.

debt_service.justification: What the debt costs each year: income spent servicing it is not available to absorb a shock.

reserves_months.display_name: Total reserves in months of imports
reserves_months.justification: The buffer against an external shock: how long imports could be paid for from reserves.

current_account.justification: Whether the economy pays its way with the rest of the world or must borrow to cover the gap.

pv_estimate.display_name: Political Stability and Absence of Violence / Terrorism, WGI estimated score
pv_estimate.justification: The perceived likelihood of political instability and politically motivated violence, terrorism included. WGI, N(0,1) scale.

state_based_deaths.display_name: Deaths in state-based armed conflict, per 100,000 people
state_based_deaths.justification: Armed conflict: UCDP's best estimate of deaths in fighting where at least one side is a government, inside the country's borders in the year. UCDP records every country-year, so a year without conflict is a measured zero, not a gap. Edition 2, step 9 (plan 1.2): one of the three parts of organised violence, scored apart so that the protection of civilians and communal violence each count on their own.

one_sided_deaths.display_name: Deaths in one-sided violence against civilians, per 100,000 people
one_sided_deaths.justification: The protection of civilians, which Interpeace makes a condition of stability (plan 1.1, 1.2): UCDP's best estimate of civilians killed deliberately by a government or an organised group in the year, inside the country's borders. A year without such killing is a measured zero. Edition 2, step 9.

organised_violence_deaths.display_name: Deaths in organised violence (state-based, non-state and one-sided), per 100,000 people
organised_violence_deaths.justification: UCDP's best estimate of everyone killed inside the country's borders in the year by state-based conflict, fighting between non-state groups and one-sided violence against civilians. Scored from step 6; from step 9 its three parts are scored instead (state_based_deaths and one_sided_deaths here, non_state_deaths in COH), and the total, their sum, is shown and not scored, so no death counts twice.

intent_homicide.justification: Everyday violence: unlawful killings with intent, excluding conflict deaths. Below the admission floor (33 of 54 states) at 2024; descriptive, shown and not scored.

femicide.justification: Intentional homicides of women. Violence, so it belongs here. Below the admission floor (33 of 54 states) at 2024; descriptive, shown and not scored.

displaced_persons.display_name: Internally displaced persons by conflict and violence (per 100,000 people)
displaced_persons.justification: People living displaced inside their own country by conflict and violence, per 100,000 people. The WDI omits states with no displacement, so a gap is often a zero it does not record. Below the admission floor (33 of 54 states) at 2024; descriptive, shown and not scored.

conflict_displacement.display_name: Internally displaced persons, new displacement associated with conflict and violence, per 100,000 people
conflict_displacement.justification: New displacements by conflict and violence in the year (IDMC via the WDI). Like the stock of displaced people, it leaves states with none blank. Below the admission floor (33 of 54 states) at 2024; descriptive, shown and not scored.

va_estimate.display_name: Voice and Accountability, WGI estimated score
va_estimate.justification: The degree to which citizens can take part in selecting their government, and freedom of expression, association and the media: accountability itself. WGI, N(0,1) scale.

women_in_parliament.display_name: Proportion of seats held by women in national parliaments (%)
women_in_parliament.justification: Representation of women in the body that makes law (Interpeace's inclusion of women). Barely correlated with any other candidate, so it carries new information.

uncertainty.interval: M ± t(k - 1) x SD/sqrt(k) over the k pillars the headline used, 95%
uncertainty.bands: two states differ when |M1 - M2| / sqrt(SE1^2 + SE2^2) > 1.96; a band runs from 1 + the states significantly above to N - those significantly below
uncertainty.tiers: the leader rule (P96): from the top, a tier holds every state not significantly below its first state; the first state significantly below starts the next
